description: Outlook & Forecasts - Drought.gov is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Integrated Drought Information System; National Drought Mitigation Center. This weekly look-ahead shows predictions for how precipitation and temperature may change in the future. Maps and other data show predicted changes from one day to 3 months into the future. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
